connector.name: AntFeed
connector.registryDescription: Discover and transact on the AntSeed P2P AI network from any MCP-compatible agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the augustas11 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: ANTFEED_EXPLORER_URL
env.description: Base URL for the AntFeed Explorer REST API.

env.name: ANTSEED_BUYER_URL
env.description: Local AntSeed buyer RPC URL. Required only for the transactional `create_session` tool; omit for read-only use.

env.name: ANTSEED_MAX_DEPOSIT_USDC
env.description: Defense-in-depth ceiling on `create_session` deposits, in USDC. Hard-capped at 10000.

env.name: ANTSEED_BUYER_STRICT
env.description: Set to 1 to require the local buyer to identify itself via /health. Recommended on shared dev boxes.
